name: azul_widgets_tab_looks_switch_together_and_the_panel_follows
description: The Tab looks section: the same three tabs drawn as Aurora (flora's curves), Rectangular and Pills (buttons on the leather), one shared selection. A click on Share in any of them selects Share in all three and the panel under them shows Share's text (it slides in from the right: a switch to a tab on the right); a click on Home brings Home's text back. The ribbon on the leather switches its own tabs (Start / Layout).

steps.text: Home: the commands you use most.
Share: send a link, invite people.
